contact_name.value: David Gruber, PhD, President – TNI Lab Director

services.value: Provides Analytical Laboratory services using custom-built facilities for static and flow-through bioassay systems, maintaining freshwater and saltwater species for Whole Effluent Toxicity (WET) testing, under a quality assurance program that satisfies U.S. EPA requirements. Also provides Environmental Consulting for aquatic toxicology, ecological risk assessment and advisory services, including evaluations, modifications, and permit negotiations with regulatory agencies.
